context: Yumiko and Sho talk about a school friend.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (太郎/加藤/あたし/辞書/そういえば) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日、太郎くんと遊んだよ!
lines.en: Mom, I played with Taro today!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、太郎くんと仲良しなのね。
lines.en: Oh, you're good friends with Taro.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 加藤先生が、絵本を読んでくれたよ。
lines.en: Mr. Kato read us a picture book.
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 加藤先生、優しいわよね。
lines.en: Mr. Kato is kind, isn't he.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そういえば、難しい言葉があったんだ。
lines.en: Come to think of it, there was a hard word.
lines.style: thoughtful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ、辞書で調べてみましょうか。
lines.en: Then shall we look it up in a dictionary?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!太郎くんにも教えてあげる!
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 辞書を引くのが、上手になったわね。
lines.en: You've gotten good at using a dictionary.
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
